definitions.explanation: A formal act or series of acts performed according to a prescribed order, often with religious or cultural significance.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{式|しき}は{神道|しんとう}の{儀式|ぎしき}で{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The wedding was held according to Shinto ritual.

examples.japanese: {儀式|ぎしき}{的|てき}な{意味合|いみあ}いが{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: It has a strong ceremonial significance.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}から{伝|つた}わる{儀式|ぎしき}を{再現|さいげん}した。
examples.english: We recreated rituals passed down from ancient times.

notes:
TYPES OF CEREMONIES:
・{宗教|しゅうきょう}{儀式|ぎしき} (religious ceremony)
・{結婚|けっこん}{儀式|ぎしき} (wedding ceremony)
・{葬|そう}{儀式|ぎしき} (funeral rites)
・{通過|つうか}{儀式|ぎしき}/{通過|つうか}儀礼 (rites of passage)
・{成人|せいじん}{儀式|ぎしき} (coming-of-age ceremony)

ADJECTIVAL USE:
・{儀式|ぎしき}{的|てき} (ceremonial, ritualistic)
・{儀式|ぎしき}{張|ば}る (to be formal/ceremonious)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{式|しき} (ceremony - simpler, often in compounds)
・{式典|しきてん} (ceremony - formal event)
・{儀礼|ぎれい} (etiquette, ceremony - formal)
・{祭礼|さいれい} (festival rites)

CULTURE: Japan has many traditional ceremonies throughout the year, including 七五三 (Shichi-Go-San), 成人式 (Coming of Age Day), and various Shinto rituals.
